package main

// Generator of relation_current_golden.json: it executes the ops
// RelationWriters / RelationEndedBy / BlockingRelation.RelationWritersOf
// functions over a fixed matrix and prints what they return. Run it with
// scripts/oracle/relation-current-golden.sh, which copies the ops file
// blocked.go (stdlib only) beside this file.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	"oraclegen/workitemmetrics"
)

type pair struct{ Source, Target string }

type goldenCase struct {
	Name             string  `json:"name"`
	Source           string  `json:"source"`
	Target           string  `json:"target"`
	Raw              string  `json:"raw"`
	Writer           *string `json:"writer"`
	RelationSynced   int64   `json:"relation_synced"`
	SourceSynced     int64   `json:"source_synced"`
	TargetSynced     int64   `json:"target_synced"`
	SourceWrites     bool    `json:"source_writes"`
	TargetWrites     bool    `json:"target_writes"`
	Current          bool    `json:"current"`
}

func main() {
	pairs := []pair{
		{"jira:OPS-1", "jira:OPS-2"},
		{"linear:PLAT-1", "linear:PLAT-2"},
		{"gh:acme/api#7", "gh:acme/api#12"},
		{"ghpr:acme/api#7", "gh:acme/api#12"},
		{"gitlab:acme/api#7", "gitlab:acme/api#12"},
		{"gh:acme/api#7", "gitlab:acme/api#12"},
		{"jira:OPS-1", "gh:acme/api#12"},
		{"gh:acme/api#7", "extkey:OPS-2"},
		{"gitlab:acme/api#7", "extkey:OPS-2"},
		{"jira:OPS-1", "extkey:OPS-2"},
		{"plain-source", "plain-target"},
	}
	raws := []string{
		"blocks", "blocked by #12", "depends on #12", "blocks #7", "Blocked  By #3", "blocked by #4",
		"DEPENDS ON #5", "blocked by", "blocking", "external_issue_key", "", "somethingelse", " blocks　#9",
	}
	writers := []*string{nil, ptr("source"), ptr("target"), ptr("both"), ptr("bogus")}
	times := [][2]int64{{1000, 1000}, {2000, 1000}, {1000, 2000}, {2000, 2000}, {500, 500}, {500, 2000}, {2000, 500}}
	base := time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	at := func(offset int64) time.Time { return base.Add(time.Duration(offset) * time.Second) }
	var out []goldenCase
	for _, p := range pairs {
		for _, raw := range raws {
			for _, writer := range writers {
				if writer != nil && raw != "blocks" && raw != "blocked by #12" && raw != "external_issue_key" {
					continue
				}
				for _, tm := range times {
					relation := workitemmetrics.BlockingRelation{
						SourceID: p.Source, TargetID: p.Target, RelationshipType: "blocks", Raw: raw,
						SemanticsVersion: workitemmetrics.CanonicalBlocksSemantics, LastSynced: at(1000), Writer: writer,
					}
					sourceWrites, targetWrites := relation.RelationWritersOf()
					var synced []time.Time
					if sourceWrites {
						synced = append(synced, at(tm[0]))
					}
					if targetWrites {
						synced = append(synced, at(tm[1]))
					}
					stored := "nil"
					if writer != nil {
						stored = *writer
					}
					out = append(out, goldenCase{
						Name:   fmt.Sprintf("%s>%s|%q|%s|%d/%d", p.Source, p.Target, raw, stored, tm[0], tm[1]),
						Source: p.Source, Target: p.Target, Raw: raw, Writer: writer,
						RelationSynced: 1000, SourceSynced: tm[0], TargetSynced: tm[1],
						SourceWrites: sourceWrites, TargetWrites: targetWrites,
						Current: workitemmetrics.RelationIsCurrent(at(1000), synced...),
					})
				}
			}
		}
	}
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	encoder.SetIndent("", " ")
	if err := encoder.Encode(out); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func ptr(s string) *string { return &s }
